purpose: Apply the shared suite community-health shell to Ask the Model while keeping application/provider/model/scientific-repository boundaries explicit.
invariants: AtM is an interface and retrieval layer, not a scientific model.
External providers and AI model files remain separate dependencies/artifacts.
Scientific repositories remain canonical for their own scientific content and validation.
Do not present AI-generated content as a canonical EWD/CBD/RMD result without repository-grounded provenance or actual model execution.
Do not weaken exact-SHA snapshot identity, fail-closed repository lifecycle or per-chat identity pinning without a reviewed architecture change.
Do not bump the application version as part of an unrelated change.
Release publication must remain tied to exact versioned release notes and the reviewed commit.
